title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 15/27 — "What Had Happened in Surrey"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 15. While George pushes through a London waking in panic, the story returns to Surrey — to the gunners waiting in the dusk, and to the narrator and the curate caught in the open as the counterstroke fails.

The batteries on St George's Hill stand to their pieces as the fighting-machines come on through the pines, green smoke drifting over the guns. One Martian is brought down — and the others answer, not with the Heat-Ray alone, but with rockets that burst into coils of heavy black vapour: the Black Smoke, rolling slow and poisonous over every battery, every hedge, every hollow where a gun or a man lies hidden.

The narrator and the curate watch it from the ditch at Halliford, crouching under the hedge as the giants stride the meadows in the moonlit mist, methodically smoking out the country. By morning the smoke lies banked over the villages like a black snowdrift, the spire of a church standing out of it, and the guns of Surrey have stopped answering. The road to London lies open.

Chapter XV of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), "What Had Happened in Surrey", in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
